title: Sesame Oil
body_html:
Rich in nutrients, IDHAYAM Gingelly Oil is pure as nature. We take special care to maintain the natural flavour and quality of the gingelly oil while extracting it from sesame seeds. As a result, IDHAYAM gingelly oil helps bring out pronounced flavours in your cooking. Essential fatty acids in our sesame oil keep your food healthy & tasty. IDHAYAM is well-suited for any type of cooking, and can be used for “oil pulling” or oil massages for more wholesome health.

Never Compromising on its Premium Raw materials, the specially, carefully selected sesame seeds are mechanically cleaned. Palm Jaggery, which has the properties of a preservative is used in the production of IDHAYAM gingelly oil.

title: Mantra Groundnut Oil
body_html:
The healthiest oil with the natural flavour of groundnuts are best for deep frying. IDHAYAM MANTRA Groundnut oil keeps you safe and healthy. As it does not reach the highest smoking point, IDHAYAM MANTRA keeps your food carcinogen-free. Also known as peanut oil, it can be used to make pooris, vadas, bajjis, bondas, parottas, and so much more.

  • IDHAYAM Mantra Groundnut oil came into existence in 2006 with the aim of making deep fried delicacies not only tasty but also healthy.
  • With specially hand-picked groundnuts of premium quality, IDHAYAM Mantra Groundnut oil has become a renowned choice amongst consumers 
  • Our quality and popularity speaks with IDHAYAM Mantra groundnut oil being exported across the globe to Singapore, Malaysia, Middle East, UK, Canada and more

title: Hardil Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil
body_html:
IDHAYAM Hardil – The Story

  • IDHAYAM Hardil Mustard oil was first launched in 2006 to cater to states in North India.
  • North Indian cuisines use mustard oil in most of their cooking and hence it is most sought after oil in these regions
  • Not only is it beneficial for consumption but also for other health purposes such as body massage and pain relieving remedies
  • IDHAYAM Hardil Mustard oil is being exported to several countries across the world including Middle East, Sri Lanka, UK, Russia and Malaysia.

IDHAYAM Hardil Mustard Oil – Benefits

  • Mustard oil extracted from mustard seeds is reddish brown in colour and has antibacterial and antiviral properties
  • Consumption of mustard oil aids in digestion, fighting infection, boost immunity, cure cold, nourish skin and hair, improve oral health and more
  • Mustard oil also is used for body massage to release muscular tension, relieve pain, improve skin texture and blood circulation

HARDIL – Mustard Oil
